# Agentic Foundry

> Governed, spec-driven delivery for agent-built software, shipped as a Claude Code plugin.
> The loop: spec → operator authorization → governed build in an isolated worktree → an
> honestly-tiered merge floor (the platform's own enforcement) → certification against the
> real running app → human sign-off. Gates make problems visible, not impossible; the
> operator's judgment is terminal by design.

Key facts for agents: the core loop is six verbs (intake, spec-review, authorize, dispatch,
certify-local, release accept); specs are atomic (stable AC-IDs, ≤14 ACs / 8,000 words, no
override); the acceptance contract is frozen (content-hashed, operator-signed) at
authorization and scope-widening requires re-authorization; certification refuses rather
than passing vacuously; there is no unattended-merge mode.
